function outOfBounds<T extends [string, number]>(tuple: T) {
  const [, , item] = tuple;
}
function readonly<T extends readonly [string, number]>(tuple: T) {
  const [a, b] = tuple;
  a.toFixed();
  b.toUpperCase();
}
function badRest<T extends readonly [string, number]>(tuple: T) {
  const [, ...tail] = tuple;
  tail[0] = "wrong";
}
function optional<T extends [string, number?]>(tuple: T) {
  const [, value] = tuple;
  value.toFixed();
}
function badAssignment<T extends [string, number]>(tuple: T) {
  let tail: [number];
  [, ...tail] = tuple;
}
